verdict.rationale: Ultrametric covers some versioning and review. Hosted process guides can be pinned to a specific integer version. Records carry revisions with conflict protection, and history can be read with `context get --history`. `init --dry-run` previews skill-file changes before writing (confirmed hands-on), and skill files can be committed to a team's repo. Rollback is not a documented feature: reverting would rely on git for skill files or on manually re-selecting an older process version, so the story is only met with extra tools and workarounds. Missing for 10: native rollback/restore of a prior run or record revision, a review/approval workflow for automation changes, versioning of user-authored automations (versions apply to vendor-managed guides), and hands-on corroboration of history and version pinning (the hosted operations require login and were not exercised).
